annotation_level: Study-level & Image-level clinical fracture classification with anatomical localization category
bounding_box_format: Implicit anatomical category (Distal, Midshaft, Proximal). Zero bounding box XMLs/TXTs in raw distribution.

evaluation_strategy.paradigm: Object detector binary & multi-view fracture validation
evaluation_strategy.fracture_detection_rule: An image is evaluated as positive (fracture detected) if YOLOv8n predicts >= 1 fracture box with confidence >= 0.17.
evaluation_strategy.study_level_rule: A study is positive if either front.jpg (AP) or side.jpg (LAT) has >= 1 detected fracture box (or max confidence >= 0.17).
evaluation_strategy.anatomical_concordance: Predicted bounding box center Y-coordinate is compared against anatomical third (Distal: bottom/top based on wrist orientation, Midshaft: middle third, Proximal: proximal third) to assess anatomical localization fidelity.
